title: Make CI proof evidence test setup map directly to the domain

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The existing assertion detects the selected fault in undeclared outcomes units.

Source: `.planning/seeds/SEED-261-share-domain-test-data.md#map-ci-proof-test-data`, completed plan `.planning/slice-plans/577-map-ci-proof-test-data/PLAN.md`, revision `897bf24c03e401634a0d667e138026913323f844`. The promise is that outcomes paths, including dashboard paths, do not invent a proof unit; undeclared outcomes remain `legacy` checks.

Fault: in `src/skills/dough-test-optimization/scripts/ci-proof-fragments.mjs:207`, changed only the `unit === undefined` branch from `{ unit: LEGACY_UNIT, label: "checks" }` to `{ unit: "case" }`.

Fixture and maintained assertion: `src/skills/dough-test-optimization/scripts/ci-proof-outcomes.test.mjs`, test `an outcomes path never declares a unit, including dashboard/tests`. Its raw passed-outcome lines cover `dashboard/tests/a.spec.ts`, `dashboard/backend-tests/a.spec.ts`, and `tests/a.spec.ts`. The independent assertion at line 16 expects `[entry, "legacy", "checks", 1]` for all three entries. Fixture and assertion bytes remained unchanged.

The same maintained command ran three times: `bash scripts/test.sh src/skills/dough-test-optimization/scripts/ci-proof-outcomes.test.mjs`. All runs used Node 24.21.0, one job, the prescribed environment cleanup, and `caffeinate -s -i` on AC power. Checkout-bound native npm, browser, and prerequisite setup passed; Chromium was 153.0.8010.12. Other owners' active suites were left untouched.

- Baseline: exit 0; the runner recorded the selected file as passed. V8 execution observation of this unchanged test body recorded count 1 for the range containing its assertion.
- Fault: exit 1; the selected assertion failed at line 16. Its actual values were `["dashboard/tests", "case", undefined, 1]`, `["dashboard/backend-tests", "case", undefined, 1]`, and `["tests", "case", undefined, 1]`, against the independently expected legacy/checks values. This directly establishes wrong behavior and assertion reach.
- Restoration: original production bytes restored from the owned backup; exit 0 on the identical command. Execution observation again recorded assertion-body count 1. Production and fixture byte comparisons passed, and Git status exactly matched the empty pre-probe state. The detached scratch checkout at the selected revision and all owned temporary probe files were removed after verification. No durable tests or execution-workspace files were changed.

- **Test runtime.** 0.7 seconds total (measured): baseline 0.2 s, fault 0.3 s, restored 0.2 s, from the maintained runner's per-job wall timings recorded to 0.1 s. These include the execution-observation overhead. Outer process wall time was 1.387 s total (measured), including runner wrappers.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable; no separate human-effort measurement was supplied or recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable; no separate agent-effort measurement was recorded. Invocation elapsed is reported separately below.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 318735 ms (measured), from 1794322663997 to 1794322982732 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
